title: The Limit Login Attempts Security WordPress plugin before 3.4.2 does not validate the destination of a server-side…
description: The Limit Login Attempts Security WordPress plugin versions before 3.4.2 contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. This flaw allows users with administrator privileges to cause the site to send requests to arbitrary hosts, including internal network addresses, due to lack of validation on a user-supplied setup value.
